{{Money|65}} on death (Hard) |spawned_by = [[Extra B]] |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = {{Attr|Bloated}} (Variable) }} ==Description== The '''Extra A''' was an enemy that appeared in [[The Narratorium]] as a part of [[The Final Act Event]]. It had higher health than the [[Fanatic]] but it was slightly slower. ==Logbook Description== "''The Extras are positioned throughout theater productions, serving as background characters in scenes and sometimes disguising themselves as objects to help move set pieces during transitions. They are typically assigned boring tasks that the Builder doesn't want to do, though their suffering is hidden beneath tear-painted masks.''" ==Appearance== The '''Extra A''' is a dark creature which wears a blue suit with crosses on it and a white vest. On its head, it wears a white mask with golden accents and a blue hat. ==Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[The Narratorium]] is listed instead. *Early-game towers like the [[Crook Boss]], [[Golden Soldier]] or [[Golden Crook Boss]] are pretty useful here. **The [[Toxic Gunner]] and [[Electroshocker]] can be used to kill multiple at once. *Later on, the '''Extra A''' becomes rather weak, meaning most towers should be capable of defeating them, including late-game towers like the [[Accelerator]], [[Turret]], [[Ranger]] or [[Pursuit]]. ==Sounds== {{Sounds|{{pe| {| class{{=}}"article-table align-center" style{{=}}"width:750px; margin:0 auto;" |- ! style{{=}}"width:30%;" |Sound ! style{{=}}"width:70%;" |Description |- ! colspan{{=}}"2" |Spawning |- |[[File:BreakerJump.ogg]] |When the '''Extra A''' spawns |- ! colspan{{=}}"2" |Abilities |- |[[File:BreakerDeath.ogg]] |When the '''Extra A''' dies |} }}}} ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} ExtraASpawn.gif|Spawning animation (20 December 2025 – Current) ExtraARun.gif|Running animation (20 December 2025 – Present) ExtraAStun.gif|Stun animation (20 December 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseExtraA.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (20 December 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} TheFinalActPI4.png|'''Extra A''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Cutscenes}} "The Final Act" Cutscenes - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Extra A''' in [[The Narratorium]] cutscenes. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} ExtraAIconIG.png|'''Extra A''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Extra A''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''20 December 2025''' - [[v1.83.0]]a **'''Extra A''' added. *'''11 March 2026''' - [[v1.86.0]] **'''Extra A''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. {{TheNarratorium|[[Fanatic]]|Wave 2|[[Sack Noob]] & Extra A|Wave 4|[[Builder]]|Wave 5}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
